newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian charged with kidnapping, raping woman.
newsitem.headline: Australian charged with kidnapping, raping woman.

text.p: An Australian man was charged on Thursday with kidnapping and rape after allegedly holding a woman captive for 12 days in his beachside home.
Allen Ormsby, 38, was remanded in custody in the Manly Magistrates Court after six charges were filed against him, including kidnapping, rape and assault.
He will appear again in court on October 30. Kidnap and rape both carry maximum 14-year jail sentences under Australian law.
According to police documents tendered in court, Ormsby held a 38-year-old unidentified woman in his apartment in Sydney's beachside suburb of Manly between September 20 and October 2.
Police said that during that time, Ormsby sexually and physically assaulted the woman, who had come to visit him.
They said the woman escaped through a window of the apartment on Wednesday.
